name: Skillet hash
intro: The week's leftovers, crisped in one pan with an egg cracked on top. A different dinner made from things you've already cooked.

proteins.name: Chicken sausage, leftover
proteins.timing: In with the pepper, about 5 minutes.

proteins.name: Eggs only
proteins.timing: No meat — four eggs in the pan instead of two.

needs: 1 sweet potato or a few kabocha wedges, in ½-inch cubes — raw or leftover

steps.text: Heat the oil in a heavy skillet until it shimmers.
Add the cubes in one layer and leave them alone until the bottoms brown. Leftover cubes need about 5 minutes; raw ones need 10, stirred once halfway.
Stir, then add the pepper and your protein. Cook until everything crisps at the edges.
Make hollows in the hash, crack in the eggs, and cover the pan until the whites set.
Your flavor on top, and a pinch of salt.

leftovers: Eat it from the pan. It's already made from leftovers.
